HELIOTRACK 2.0

HELIOTRACK returns with its second edition — HELIOTRACK 2.0

Get ready for a one-day, hands-on workshop designed for curious innovators and space enthusiasts who love blending astronomy with technology.

Step into the world of Solar Physics and Solar Tech, where you’ll:
🔸 Design and build Sun Sensors
🔸 Track the Planets through coding

This workshop isn’t just about learning — it’s about creating, experimenting, and bringing solar technology to life.
Gain practical skills in solar tracking, coding, and electronics, while discovering the science and innovation behind the Sun’s immense power.
